title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on The City Co-operative Bank, Hassan, Karnataka
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated July 17, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) on The City Co-operative Bank, Hassan, Karnataka (the bank) for non-compliance with certain directions issued by RBI on ‘Know Your Customer (KYC)’.
